verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's own docs describe creating scoped API keys with limited permissions via `vastai create api-key`, and a dedicated API-keys page covers creating, scoping, rotating and revoking keys for the CLI, SDK and REST API. Agents use these same surfaces through the official agent skill, so a key can be issued with only the permissions an agent workload needs. Missing for 10: documentation of the actual permission granularity or scope list, explicit guidance on scoping keys for agents (the docs cite CI/CD and shared tooling), and independent or hands-on corroboration that scoped keys work as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: You can also create scoped keys with limited permissions using `vastai create api-key`, useful for CI/CD or shared tooling.
